name: Dondi Dahlin
reason: Health rule: her YouTube channel (@DondiDahlin, 3.7k subscribers) is, apart from belly-dance performance clips, mostly short Eden Energy Medicine tips named after conditions ('How to Relieve Migraines Fast', 'Do this to relieve headaches', 'Energy Tip for Allergies', 'balance your hormones', 'energy medicine and weight', 'Detox Your System', 'Better Sleep'), and her own site (dondidahlin.com) sells her Five Elements work on health ('unlocks your path to health', which organs are 'susceptible to illness, injury, and disease', 'overcome health and relationship challenges'); one of her listed talks is 'Healing Grief with Energy Medicine'. Otherwise listable: email dondi@dondidahlin.com (Meet Dondi page), The Five Elements (TarcherPerigee 2016, ISBN 9780399176296 on her site), a free quiz and class, and her site links The Shift Network ('Five Elements Through Belly Dance & Ceremony'; an interview with Bruce Lipton for the Shift Network). No base published. Note: dondidahlin.com/robots.txt redirects to itself; robots was read on www.learnthefiveelements.com (the same WordPress site, Yoast 'Disallow:' for *), which redirects to dondidahlin.com. The owner may want to weigh the Five Elements personality work separately.
